commands.command:
set -eu
old_boot_id=cd201c7e-7a27-4b28-a631-737e59cba357
new_boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
test "$new_boot_id" != "$old_boot_id"
printf 'post_restart_boot_id=%s\nboot_id_changed=yes\n' "$new_boot_id"
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'redis_active='; systemctl is-active redis-server
printf 'redis_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled redis-server
printf 'redis_pid='; systemctl show redis-server -p MainPID --value
printf 'credential_file='; stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/redis-inventory.env
. /etc/redis-inventory.env
test "$REDIS_HOST" = "$NODE_IP"
unauth_output=$(redis-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" PING 2>&1 || true)
printf '%s\n' "$unauth_output" | grep -q 'NOAUTH Authentication required'
printf 'unauthenticated_access=denied\n'
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
printf 'inventory_ping='; redis-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" --raw PING
printf 'inventory_identity='; redis-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" --raw ACL WHOAMI
printf 'recovered_durable_value='; redis-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" --raw GET inventory:persistence-proof
printf 'persistence_state='; redis-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" --raw INFO persistence | tr -d '\r' | awk -F: '/^loading:|^rdb_last_bgsave_status:|^aof_enabled:|^aof_rewrite_in_progress:|^aof_last_write_status:/{printf "%s=%s ",$1,$2} END{print ""}'
printf 'listener='; ss -ltn | awk -v ip="$NODE_IP:6379" '$4 == ip {print $4}'
printf 'aof_files:\n'; find /var/lib/redis/appendonlydir -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s-bytes\n' | sort
unset REDISCLI_AUTH REDIS_PASSWORD
